tut.s1.b: Each agent — Claude, Codex, and more — is tracked in its own tab. The number badge is unread notifications; the pin sets which tab opens first. Pick which agents get a tab via the + button or settings.
tut.s2.b: The same 5-hour and weekly utilization as the /usage command. Yellow means over 70%, red pulsing means over 90%.
tut.s3.b: Today and last-7-days tokens aggregated from your local transcripts, with per-model chips. The chart button opens hourly/daily/monthly graphs.
tut.s4.b: Sessions running right now. Click a row to jump to that session's window; the folder chip opens the project folder. Right-click a row to hide it.
tut.s5.b: History of finished work and input requests. The orange dot marks unread — click a row or use 'Read all'. Clicking a row jumps to the window that session ran in.
tut.s6.b: The expand button grows the window for long lists. Once expanded, a search button appears to filter by title, content, or project.
tut.s7.b: Each press of the bell cycles On → Alerts only → Quiet → Silent, controlling OS notifications and unread badges. Also available in settings.
tut.s8.b: Current version and the update check. When a new release exists you can apply it right here. The restart button relaunches the daemon; the GitHub button opens the repo. Reopen this tour anytime with the ? button above.
